note: The bands the AeroTetris C-130 Hercules 3077 plant has to land in, from docs/HERCULES-STAGE1.md, which derives each from AeroTetris's published figures, the full size C-130H scaled to the kit, E-flite's for the Power 25 and APC's for the 12 x 8E (scripts/hercules-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Kadet's in proportion about its derived figure, as the Kadet's are the Bombshell's. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

h1_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.67 at 6.728 kg on the kit's 104.86 dm^2 and CLmax 1.10; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.10 / 5.688, of the zero lift line

h2_cruise.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, derived 16.69, the Kadet's cruise stick; the scale pace of 1.6 Vs, 15.5 m/s, is flown at 70 percent

h3_glide.source: power off at 1.25 Vs, 12.08 m/s: L/D derived 10.53, a sink of 1.15 m/s

h4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 22.57

h5_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from standing, the wings held on the ailerons and the heading on the rudder, the elevator eased up from 1.1 Vs: it lifts off between 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, and between the rolls to those speeds at the rest attitude, 7.12 and 16.13 m (hercules:derive)

h6_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.2604 m up and 10.75 percent of the weight on the nose wheel (hercules:derive), within half a degree, 5 mm and a fifth of the share, the Kadet's

h9_doors.source: O in level cruise at 75 percent: the ramp and door open in their 4 s, and the open hold and ramp's drag, 0.0259 on the wing (hercules:derive, ESTIMATED from Hoerner's base drag and plate), slow the level speed to a derived 15.37 m/s, 1.32 under H2's; the band H2's in proportion, the drop within a third. An aircraft without doors refuses them

h7_unmoved.source: every other aircraft's recorded flight hash, as tests/kadet-thresholds.json s17_unmoved and tests/extra-thresholds.json hold them: adding airframe 30 moves none. The Extra's own pinned from main's module at 10fc77de, before the Hercules

h8_cross_host.source: the Hercules' recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
